## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Yas Island, Abu Dhabi.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> At Yas Waterworld you'll find rides for rambunctious adrenaline junkies and their slightly younger sibling, the boisterous thrill-seeker. There are plenty of lazy, chilled-out attractions for the more mellow amongst us and a ton of fun for the young. Come on down and cool off at Yas Waterworld. There's even a unique pearl diving attraction that showcases traditional Emirati pearl diving.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €77.05. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 26 ratings and 18 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
